_purpose: Cowork-owned interpretation layer for the academic-research feed. Append-only. NEVER regenerated or overwritten by any fetcher or script. Each row interprets and taxonomy-tags one material item drawn from the raw feed named in source_feed. Held in a separate file from the raw feed because that feed is overwritten in full on every fetch (a news refresh once wiped 150 entity-tagged items — see data_exposure/interpretation separation).
source_feed_owner: scripts/fetch_research.py (OpenAlex) — fetcher-owned, overwritten in full on each run
dedup_key_note: doi is the canonical key. ~11 of every 200 current OpenAlex papers carry no DOI; the sweep must fall back to the OpenAlex work id / url for those, or skip them — never emit a row with an empty dedup key.
enum_authority: data/registries/taxonomy.json — sectors, subsectors and the 9 value_chain_tier values are authoritative there (also listed in CLAUDE.md).
